devdoc.author: SmArt
devdoc.details: A contract for managing gigs where clients post work requests and freelancers apply with proposals.

acceptApplication(uint256,uint256).details: Accept an application (Client accepts freelancer's proposal)

addCommentToGig(uint256,string).details: Allows the client to add a response to the last uploaded file.

applyToGig(uint256,(uint256,uint256,stri.details: Apply to a gig (Freelancer submits application)

params._gigId: The ID of the gig to apply for
params.params: struct containing proposed payment, duration, and proposal comment

confirmCompletion(uint256).details: Confirm gig completion (both parties must confirm to complete the gig)

params._gigId: The gig ID to confirm completion

params._arbitrator: Address of the arbitrator for dispute resolution

emergencyCancel(uint256).details: Emergency cancel by owner (with full refund to client)

params._gigId: The gig ID to emergency cancel

rateGig(uint256,uint8).details: Rate the gig (only client can rate after completion)

rejectApplication(uint256,uint256,string.details: Reject an application (Client rejects freelancer's proposal)

params._rejectionComment: Comment explaining why the application was rejected

startDispute(uint256,string,uint256,uint.details: Start a dispute for a gig (either party can start a dispute)

params._bondAmount: Amount to be used as bond for the first answer
params._bountyAmount: Amount to be used as bounty for the dispute
params._comment: Comment explaining the reason for the dispute
params._escalateToArbitrator: Whether to escalate the dispute to an arbitrator immediately
params._gigId: The ID of the gig to dispute

uploadFile(uint256,(string,string,bool)).details: Allows the freelancer to upload a file.

params._fileParams: The content of the file (IPFS hash and comment).

devdoc.title: GigsContract
